name: Pomodoro
author: Wilbur Lindqvist (techywilbur)
description: Pomodoro focus timer for the Omarchy bar: a countdown in the bar, a popup with transport controls, focus presets and break buttons, a full-screen break screen with a progress ring, Do Not Disturb while you focus, chimes, notifications and daily stats. Survives shell restarts and suspend.

barWidget.description: Focus timer with a break screen and DND during focus

schema.label: Long break after every N focus blocks
schema.description: 0 disables long breaks and the session dots.

schema.label: Silence notifications while focusing
schema.description: Turns on Do Not Disturb for the length of a focus block and restores the previous state afterwards.

schema.label: Full-screen break screen
schema.description: Cover every monitor with a break screen during breaks. Esc hides it, Space skips the break.

schema.label: Chime at the end of a block
Desktop notification at the end of a block
Start the break automatically when focus ends
Start the next focus automatically when a break ends
schema.description: Off: wait for you to press Start (or Enter on the break screen).

schema.label: Drop a restored timer if it ended more than N minutes ago
